evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 5.5 ppm, near the established post-purge baseline of approximately 3–6 ppm.
Oxygen increased to 13.2 ppm during growth.
Oxygen reached 33.2 ppm, a sustained departure from the post-purge baseline.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon 99.9 sccm track setpoints; heater power 44.6% and pressure 761.0 Torr remain stable, while status still reports running.

args.missing_evidence: An independent oxygen measurement and gas-supply/seal integrity checks are needed to distinguish air ingress from feed contamination, oxygen release, or oxygen-sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
